value.rationale: The first two centered Poisson-Charlier modes are a canonical finite-dimensional mixed-chaos space. The sharp L4/L2 interval and all extremizing lines are determined uniformly over the Poisson intensity, and the exact onset of two nonglobal stationary directions exhibits a nontrivial saddle-node optimization geometry absent in the familiar Gaussian/Laguerre two-mode cases. The proof establishes why the additional local minimum never changes the true sharp lower constant, not just a parameter slice or numerical threshold.
